name: Codigoro (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Codigoro (a stag on white above green) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Codigoro, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Codigoro arms — stag on white above green, crowned, within branches
